newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan, Bahrain sign trade and investment deal.
newsitem.headline: Jordan, Bahrain sign trade and investment deal.

text.p: Jordan and Bahrain signed a cooperation accord on Tuesday aimed at increasing trade and investment between the two Arab states, the official Petra news agency said.
It said the agreement aimed at encouraging joint projects between the two countries, boosting bilateral trade and removing bureaucratic obstacles to business.
The deal was signed by Jordan's union of chambers of commerce, Amman's chamber of industry and Bahrain's chamber of commerce and industry.
It was signed on the sidelines of Bahrain's first industrial exhibition in Jordan.
The agreement calls for exchange of information about business and manufacturing opportunities in the two countries, as well as job opportunities for Jordanians and Bahrainis.
Jordan's Central Bank bulletin said that Jordan exported goods to Bahrain last year worth 14 million dinars ($20 million), while its imports from the Gulf state stood at 20 million dinars.
